method.authorization: Owner explicitly requested filling every calorie field using research and estimates from similarly named drinks or ingredients.
method.classification: All54 are model estimates; zero directly published matching iTEA energy values found. No calorie derived from Nutri-Grade, pictured sugar percentage or another brand claimed as iTEA measurement.
method.preparation: Reference cane-sugar, regular-ice order;50% for tea/milk/matcha/Milo; fruit minimum/no-added and fixed-sweetness preparations. Proxies retain intrinsic sugar. Included toppings counted once; optional extras excluded.
method.servingBasis: Assumed nominal Medium500ml and Large700ml as generic Singapore reference, not verified iTEA volumes. Whole-cup reference energy includes included toppings; per100ml uses nominal cup volume, including melted regular ice.
method.equations: M = sum(amountM × energyKcalPerBasis / basisAmount); L = unroundedM ×700/500; per100ml = unroundedM ×100/500. Each ingredient portion is assumed to scale1.4× for L.
method.rounding: Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to whole cup kcal and one decimal per100ml; strip trailing decimal zeros; no units/estimate labels inside Airtable cells.
method.proxyChoices: Match tea/dairy/fruit/blended family first. Teas contribute negligible energy beyond named donor recipe. Grape uses lychee fruit tea; starfruit uses yuzu fruit tea; guava uses mango fruit tea; tamarind uses sweet citrus drink; passionfruit uses lychee fruit tea. These are composition-family proxies, not identical recipes.
method.uncertainty: Actual cup fill, ice, ingredient brands, scoop size, milk fraction and sugar dose are unknown. Values are practical reference estimates, not lab measurements, official iTEA nutrition or calibrated predictions.
method.sensitivity: For each item, independent low/high scenario varies all estimated ingredient portions by±25%; these are scenario bounds, not confidence intervals, and are not written to Airtable.
